item.title: Chewing gum cuts HPV levels by up to 93%
item.description: A special chewing gum reduced HPV by up to 93% and nearly eliminated two bacteria linked to head and neck cancer.

item.title: Ancient sea creature reveals origin of spider fangs
item.description: A 518-million-year-old sea creature shows the earliest known evidence of structures that evolved into spider fangs.
